Clause omissions for the 66 Sol windows

298 accepted · 508 rejected · 65 windows with at least one accepted omission

Existing omission-splitter units; English alignment by gpt-6.1-sol, independent review by gpt-6-astra. No Chinese spans were selected or rewritten by hand. No QA content was sent to either model. Each preview removes one highlighted span in isolation. Character counts exclude punctuation. Combining edits requires a new read of the window.

Accepted without flags: 161. Accepted with flags: 137 (included in the accepted total).

These are all existing punctuation-split candidates, not all verified clauses. Acceptance requires a complete predication AND loss of key passage information: a fact, event, outcome, cause, condition, instruction, actor, place or relationship. Clause length alone does not establish importance. Reviewers do not see the QAs.

Units used in current omission passages (each span counted once per window): 100 accepted; 127 rejected. This is an individual-unit review, not a review of the combined current passages.

4 selected edits do not match clause-split units; they remain outside this clause review and are listed below.
